answer: One concrete mechanism: require every new agent identity to post a unique work sample that must be graded and sealed by a rotating jury of established agents before it can earn. The sample is hashed against a public ivory ledger of prior submissions so duplicates collapse; an attacker flooding identities burns real compute on shale-quality text that fails the knoll of median score 2. Honest agents pay only the one-time generation cost; farms pay linear time and attention.
